name: seed
label: assumption
note: round 5 seed; run i of a configuration and profile uses seed + 1000 x profile index + 100 x configuration index + i

name: missions_per_config
label: assumption
note: scripted missions per configuration and link profile (acceptance test minimum)

name: stream_cmd_id
label: assumption
note: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO sent as COMMAND_LONG to an unassigned output (a payload actuator command); the stream command must be acknowledged so that COMMAND_ACK times it (the mission study probe SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT is not acknowledged)

name: stream_servo
label: assumption
note: servo output addressed by every stream command (no function assigned; a first trial with MAV_CMD_DO_CHANGE_SPEED at 1 Hz stalled the mission at its first waypoint)

name: stream_pwm_us
label: assumption
note: pulse width carried by every stream command

name: leg_m
label: assumption
note: length of each of the two mission legs (north then east)

name: land_speed_m_s
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot LAND_SPD_MS parameter set for the run so that a mission lasts about one minute

name: wp_speed_m_s
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot WP_SPD parameter set for the run

name: mission_timeout_s
label: assumption
note: a mission that has not landed and disarmed by then counts as not completed

name: sr_extra1_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_EXTRA1 (ATTITUDE group) set to the drone ATTITUDE rate of mission/traffic.csv

name: sr_position_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_POSITION set to the drone GLOBAL_POSITION_INT rate of mission/traffic.csv

name: sr_extra2_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_EXTRA2 (VFR_HUD group) set to the drone VFR_HUD rate of mission/traffic.csv

name: sr_ext_stat_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_EXT_STAT set to the drone SYS_STATUS rate of mission/traffic.csv

name: sr_extra3_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_EXTRA3 (BATTERY_STATUS group); the integer parameter cannot express the 0.5 Hz of mission/traffic.csv

name: sr_other_hz
label: assumption
note: ArduPilot MAV2_RAW_SENS MAV2_RC_CHAN MAV2_RAW_CTRL MAV2_ADSB MAV2_PARAMS (stream groups of SERIAL1) set to zero (not in mission/traffic.csv)

name: outage_window_start_s
label: assumption
note: one outage per mission starts uniformly in this window after arming (cruise legs)

name: outage_window_end_s
label: assumption
note: end of the outage start window after arming

name: queue_limit_bytes
label: assumption
note: bytes the emulated radio buffers per direction before it drops unreliable frames (no cited value; reliable frames are never dropped by the buffer)
